protocol.fixed_refinement: Initial mixed solve plus exactly2or4 corrections; each correction pays one original core product. No unused final core check.
protocol.tolerance_refinement: Check original core residual against1e-10; at most6corrections; stop after two consecutive reductions less than10percent. Return truncated action and record reason.
protocol.original_checks: Every4outer iterations, suspected convergence, and final termination. Failed recursive stopping is reported, no replacement/restart fallback.
protocol.setup: Charged original FP64 FPS and streamed core factorization for every attempt.
protocol.scope: Bounded static representation pilot; not adaptive goal achievement. Common immutable X,b separate, no dense matrix during solver/audit.
